fields.columns: | columns event.time, event.type, site.name, agent.uuid, src.process.storyline.id, src.process.user, src.process.uid, src.process.cmdline, src.ip.address, src.port.number, dst.ip.address, dst.port.number, src.process.parent.cmdline, tgt.process.cmdline
fields.description: Detects chromium based browsers starting in headless and debugging mode and pointing to a user profile. This could be a sign of data stealing or remote control
fields.name: Potential Data Stealing Via Chromium Headless Debugging
fields.query: event.type="Process Creation" and (endpoint.os="windows" and (tgt.process.cmdline contains "--remote-debugging-" and tgt.process.cmdline contains "--user-data-dir" and tgt.process.cmdline contains "--headless"))
